Nullifying the effects of a taweez from Amal-e-Qurani 9437 views Q. میں یہ پوچھنا چاہوں گاکہ تسبیح فاطمی پڑھتے وقت انگلیوں کے سرے سے گننے کے لیے دو نوں ہاتھ کا استعمال کرسکتے ہیں یا یا صرف ایک ہاتھ کا استعمال کرسکتے ہیں؟براہ کرم، اس معاملے میں تفصیل سے بتائیں۔ 1467 views Q. assalamalaykum i am affected by black magic (sifli ilm) so what is the islamic way of treating sifli ilm,and please give me the address and name of the person who can treat it especially in hyderabad (india) . one amil is saying he will treat me by things like bathing in water of three rivers and by using head and legs of a goat etc... is it permisible in islam? is going to a certain place like "rehmatabad " where there is dargah, and staying there and praying to allah to get cured (particularly in that place) allowed? please do reply soon. 25776 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2470 views Q. دو مہینے پہلی میری شادی ہوئی تھی، ہم میاں بیوی میں دھیردھیرے دوری پیدا ہوگئی ہے، غلط فہمیاں اور بڑھتی ہی جارہی ہے، نہ چاہنے کے باوجود یہ ہورہا ہے، کوئی کہتاہے اثر ہے ، کوئی کہتاہے جنات کا معاملہ ہے، کچھ سمجھ میں نہیں آرہاہے، آپ سے گذارش ہے کہ میری مدد فرمائیں اور ہمارے رشتے کو ٹوٹنے سے بچائیں، اللہ آپ کو اس کا بدلہ دے گا، ان شاء اللہ ۔ میری بیوی کا نام شگفتہ انصاری ہے، ان کی والدہ کا نام خیر النساء ہے اور میرا نام آفتاب انصاری اور والدہ کا نام فریدہ انصاری ہے۔ براہ کرم، جواب دیں تاکہ رشتوں کی نفرت محبت میں بدل جائے ۔ 1660 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 1095 Country: India Title: I have a great hair fall, please give me any wazeefa for regrowth and control of hairs. My age is 19 years. Please, suggest me, i am unable to bear the loss. Question: I have a great hair fall, please give me any wazeefa for regrowth and control of hairs. My age is 19 years. Please, suggest me, i am unable to bear the loss. Answer ID: 1095 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 527/516=N) Get it treated by any expert doctor or hakim and keep on reciting this dua eleven times after every obligatory salah with durood three times before and after: رب انی مسّنی الضر و انت ارحم الراحمین Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
